newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TABLE - UCB H1 ordinary profit up 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - UCB H1 ordinary profit up 33 pct.

text.p: (in millions of Belgian francs unless stated)
NOTE - Belgian drugs, fine chemicals and plastic films group UCB said it expected full year 1997 ordinary profit to rise by about 30 percent, in line with the 1996 increase.

NOTE - Chief executive officer Georges Jacobs told a news conference on first half results that for the group as a whole the prospects remained very favourable; ordinary profits were expected to continue their growth in 1997.
"Profits should keep up with the trend that we know today... the group is in good health," he said.

Asked whether dividends would grow at the same rate as profits in 1997, Jacobs said, "So far in the last 10 years I have never seen a payout ratio above 35 percent...we will continue our moderate payout policy."
He said that on the back of that policy UCB's own funds had doubled over the last seven years, helping the group fund research and development.
